import importlib.util,inspect,textwrap,unittest,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/work-graph-completion-cases.py').resolve()
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m6_chain_mutant',p);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m)
name='test_m6_strict_chain_keeps_consequential_join_on_serial_path'
source=textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(getattr(m.CompletionCases,name)))
old='self.nodes[2]["requires"] = ["A"]'
assert source.count(old)==1
source=source.replace(old,'self.nodes[2]["requires"] = []')
exec(compile(source,str(p)+'::missing-dependency-mutant','exec'),m.__dict__)
setattr(m.CompletionCases,name,m.__dict__[name])
result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.TestSuite([m.CompletionCases(name)]))
sys.exit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1)
